provenance.construction: 2BGA coset code (kit coset.build_coset) on group mc(3,18,2) (|G|=54) with non-normal subgroup H = [0, 6, 12, 22, 28, 34, 38, 44, 50], a = [0, 24, 43, 45] (subset of G), b = [0, 30] (subset of N_G(H)); element indices of the Cayley table (identity = 0; convention in the note)

search_budget.tool: research/kit 2BGA sweep + gf2_fast on Brev n2d-highcpu-64

references: arXiv:2306.16400 (isomorphic to the archive row 6 2 4 3 [ 3 ] [ 2, 3, 6 ] of the abelian enumeration, github.com/QEC-pages/2BGA-codes @ 403d194c3f98, rebuilt on research/kit/groups/smallgroup_6_2.json; issue #3658)

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil flagged interleaved two-block extraction (max_flags=3 per check, 7 data CX slots per round, X-check term slots [5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 3], Z-check term slots [1, 4, 5, 2, 0, 3] over terms A_0..A_3, B_0..B_1); verified against stim 1.16.0; RIS DEM search found nothing lighter than the claimed d_circ (generator: seed 0xC18C, 12 s per basis; independent re-check: seeds 0x5EED01 and 0x5EED02 at 1.5x the gate's trial budget, 180 s cap per basis)
